Triage: routed `domain:skills` + `finding` + `documentation`, type Task. The five sites live in `skills/**` (published skills — governed, human-merge-only) and the skills lane self-triages its findings, so no grading here. Two notes for that seat: ① the mirror row in `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx:156` must move in the same change as `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:19` per the body's drift argument; ② published-skills PRs carry the whole-package value-density review question and the net-line budget discipline.

The published `skills/**` catalog is the platform's highest-value external face (maintainer 2026-08-21), and five sites teaching a removed surface are exactly the input that generates client code against a 404 — plus the `/storage` staleness noted in passing on the same line. The mirror (`ai/skills-reference.mdx`) corrects in the SAME change, per the card. Batch note: dispatches alongside the sharingModel-examples card (same catalog face) with a file-overlap check at dispatch; fold only if the surfaces intersect. Governed face — draft PR, human merge.
